id: title:fivestarspicy:deeplink observation evidence for mcp agents

review.posthog_relevance: Adds session ID and agent-facing instructions to the URL and metadata used for retrieving session observation records, potentially aiding debugging or support workflows.
review.reason: The observed changes are localized additions of an `enrich_url` parameter and an `agent_note` field to session observation retrieval. This represents a narrow, maintenance-like enhancement to the retrieval tool's metadata and agent instructions rather than a substantive change to query planning, data integrity, or systemic reliability. No broader capability or systemic risk is seen
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and its exact impact on PostHog's support or debugging workflows are not demonstrated; the benefit is inferred from the presence of the fields rather than observed behavior or test results.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single grouped change. No tier assignment is made here; scoring is done after reviewing the complete group.

observations.behavior: Adds an agent-facing instruction and URL prefix to the session observation retrieval tool.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a session ID to the URL used for replay observation retrieval, while also adding an agent note explaining how to use the URL and timestamp for deep-linking.
